title: Resume AI
summary: An AI-assisted resume tailoring workflow that turns confirmed profile facts and job postings into truthful, one-page HTML and PDF resumes.
description: Resume AI is a practical job-search city: a local workflow for converting a canonical resume into targeted variants without losing factual grounding.

The project pairs editable HTML resumes with a long-form profile inventory, application tracking, and PDF verification so AI help stays useful, specific, and honest instead of becoming unsupported keyword stuffing.

Public proof points for job-search narrative

highlights: Uses a canonical local resume plus a broader profile inventory as the source of truth.
Creates company-and-role-specific resume folders instead of mutating the master copy for every application.
Renders HTML resumes to PDF and verifies the result stays exactly one page.
productionQueue: Keep strengthening the intake flow for job links and missing-but-truthful details.
Improve reusable prompts for role analysis, ATS vocabulary, and supported claim checking.
Expand application tracking so each submitted resume remains easy to audit later.

architectureNotes: Keeps private canonical files ignored while shipping public samples and repeatable workflow guidance.
Separates broad confirmed profile facts from focused one-page resume variants so tailoring can be specific without inventing experience.
